mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT IRBNO AS irbNo, RESKORNM AS irbKrNm, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(AVAISTARTDT, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fromDt, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(AVAIENDDT, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS toDt, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(APPROVEDT, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approvedDt, IRBMETHOD as irbType, (CASE WHEN IRBMETHOD = '1' THEN '정규' WHEN IRBMETHOD = '2' THEN '신속' WHEN IRBMETHOD = '3' THEN '긴급' WHEN IRBMETHOD = '4' THEN '면제' WHEN IRBMETHOD = '5' THEN '공동' ELSE '미승인' END) as irbTypeDesc, (CASE WHEN HUMINRMANCT = 0 THEN NULL ELSE HUMINRMANCT END) AS ptCnt FROM NCRIS.V_IRBAPPROVAL_CDW_VIEW WHERE 1 = 1 AND PROFESSORID = #{stfNo} AND ( AVAIENDDT >= TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR (IRBMETHOD = '4' AND (AVAIENDDT >= TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR AVAIENDDT IS NULL)))) ORDER BY approvedDt
